::: {.lead}
I am a Software Engineer II at Estes Express Lines on the Agentic Development Life Cycle (ADLC) team, a proof of concept where engineers define the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria and AI agents do much of the planning, development, testing, and remediation. I am super passionate about front and back end web development (full stack), as well as general software development for desktop applications, etc. Please check out the [Blog](blog.qmd) page to see coding projects from both my personal and academic career.
:::

```{=html}
<script>
const timeline = document.getElementById('timeline');
const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
const canAnimate = !reduceMotion && 'IntersectionObserver' in window;
let isNewestFirst = true;
let revealObserver = null;

function revealItem(item, delayMs) {
  item.style.setProperty('--reveal-delay', `${delayMs}ms`);
  item.classList.add('is-visible');
  if (revealObserver) revealObserver.unobserve(item);
}

if (canAnimate) {
  timeline.classList.add('reveal-ready');

  // Fade/slide each card in the first time it scrolls into view, staggering cards that arrive together
  revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
      .sort((a, b) => a.boundingClientRect.top - b.boundingClientRect.top)
      .forEach((entry, i) => revealItem(entry.target, i * 120));
  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -15% 0px', threshold: 0.15 });
  Array.from(timeline.children).forEach((item) => revealObserver.observe(item));

  // Draw the center line down to the same point where cards are revealed
  let ticking = false;
  function updateLine() {
    ticking = false;
    const rect = timeline.getBoundingClientRect();
    const atBottom = window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.documentElement.scrollHeight - 2;
    const progress = atBottom ? 1 : (window.innerHeight * 0.85 - rect.top) / rect.height;
    timeline.style.setProperty('--line-progress', Math.min(Math.max(progress, 0), 1));
  }
  function requestLineUpdate() {
    if (!ticking) {
      ticking = true;
      requestAnimationFrame(updateLine);
    }
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', requestLineUpdate, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', requestLineUpdate);
  updateLine();
}

// Skills: badges pop in one after another when their group scrolls into view
if (canAnimate) {
  const skills = document.getElementById('skills-grid');
  skills.classList.add('reveal-ready');
  skills.querySelectorAll('.skill-badges').forEach((list) => {
    Array.from(list.children).forEach((badge, i) => badge.style.setProperty('--badge-index', i));
  });

  const skillsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
    entries
      .filter((entry) => entry.isIntersecting)
      .sort((a, b) => a.boundingClientRect.top - b.boundingClientRect.top || a.boundingClientRect.left - b.boundingClientRect.left)
      .forEach((entry, i) => {
        entry.target.style.setProperty('--group-delay', `${i * 200}ms`);
        entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
        skillsObserver.unobserve(entry.target);
      });
  }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -10% 0px', threshold: 0.2 });
  skills.querySelectorAll('.skill-group').forEach((group) => skillsObserver.observe(group));
}

function toggleTimelineOrder() {
  const items = Array.from(timeline.children);
  const before = new Map(items.map((item) => [item, item.getBoundingClientRect()]));
  items.reverse();

  // Re-append in reversed order and reassign left/right classes for alternating layout (first item on the right)
  items.forEach((item, index) => {
    item.classList.remove('left', 'right');
    item.classList.add(index % 2 === 0 ? 'right' : 'left');
    timeline.appendChild(item);
  });

  // Slide each card from its old position to its new one (FLIP)
  if (canAnimate) {
    items.forEach((item) => {
      revealItem(item, 0);
      const from = before.get(item);
      const to = item.getBoundingClientRect();
      const dx = from.left - to.left;
      const dy = from.top - to.top;
      if (dx || dy) {
        item.animate(
          [{ transform: `translate(${dx}px, ${dy}px)` }, { transform: 'none' }],
          { duration: 700, easing: 'cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.2, 1)' }
        );
      }
    });
  }

  // Button names the order you'll get on the next click
  isNewestFirst = !isNewestFirst;
  document.getElementById('toggle-label').textContent = isNewestFirst ? "Show oldest first" : "Show newest first";
}
</script>
```
